paite: Huan Naomi in apasal tanau, Elimelek beh, mineizoutak tanau anei a; amin Boaz ahi.
heading: Ruth In Boaz Lou Ah Asem

paite: Moab mi Ruth in Naomi kiang ah, "Lou ah ka va hoh dia, buhsang ka va zong ding aw, hon deihsakmi kuate hiam va tuak moh lou ka hi,” achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hoh in, ka tanu," achi hi.
Huchi in ahohta a, buh la mite lakmaih ava zong a; huchi in Elimelek beh Boaz lou ah ava hoh kha geih hi.
Huchi in ngai in, Bethlehem a pan Boaz ava hoh a, buh la mite kiang ah, “Na kiang uah TOUPA om hen," achi hi. Amau, “TOUPA'N nang hon vualzawl hen,” chi in adawng uhi.
Huchi in Boaz in asikha, buh la mite tung a heutu kiang ah, “Hiai kua nungaknou ahia oi?” achi hi.
Abuh la mite tung a heutu asikha in, "Moab nungaknou, Moab gam a pan Naomi toh hong pai ahi.

Ama'n, 'hon hehpih inla, na buhsang ka zong dia, buh la mite'n abuhphal uh alakkhawm khit chiang un ka zong zel ding aw' achi hi. Huchi in ahong pai a, inn a tomchik a-om chih louh zingsang a pan a-om nilouh hi," chi in adawng hi.
Huchi in Boaz in Ruth kiang ah, "Ka tanu, ngai dih, buhsang zong in lou dang ah hoh ke'nla, hiai a pan paisuan ke'n. Ka sikha nungakte kiang ah om gige in.
Abuhlak uh en gige inla, anung uh sui zel in. Tangvalte nang bangmah hon chih lou ding in thu ka pevekta hi. Na dangtak peuh chiang in tuibel a tangvalte tui tawisa dawn zel in," achi hi.
Huchi in akun a, lei si in abokkhup a, akiang ah, "Namdang hinapi ing a, nang hichibang a na hon theihnop a, na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tan bangchidan ahia?" achi hi.

Boaz in adawng a, akiang ah, "Na pasal sih nungsiah na pi tung a na thilhihdan tengteng mi'n ahon hilh vek uh. Na nu leh na pa leh na pianna gam paisan atum a lam a na mi theih ngeilouhte kiang a na hong paidante leng.
TOUPA'N na thilhih hon din henla, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, kihumbitna dia akha nuai na muan in kipahman tampi hon pia hen," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka toupa, na mitmuh in deihsakna ka tang a, na hon lungmuan a, na sikha nungakte lak a mi hi kei mah leng, na sikhanu hoihtak in na hon houpihta ngal a,” achi hi.

An nek hun in Boaz in akiang ah, "Hong pai inla, tanghoute hong ne sam inla, tanghou themte uain thuk ah hong diah in,” achi hi. Huchi in buh la mite kiang ah atu a; buhkan apia a; ane a, anek nung in leng akhamval lai hi.
Buhsang zong dia adin nawn in, Boaz in atangvalte kiang ah, "Buhphalte lak ah leng tawmsak zel unla, tai kei un.
Alomte leng dohkhiaksak unla, nutsiat zel unla, tom henla, tai kei un," chỉ in thu apia hi.
Huchi in lou a buhsang nitaklam tan in azong hi. Azonsa akhen a, barli buh ephah khat hiamtak apha hi.
Avan kisuan in khopi ah apaita hi. Api in abuhsang zon ana mu a; ama'n anek kham val asitte asuahkhia a, apia hi.

Api in akiang ah, "Tuni a koilam a buhsang zong na hia? Koi ah ahia na va sep? Ahon na theinuampa vualzawl in om hen," achi hi. Ama'n kua kiang ah ahia ava sep chih api ahilh hi. "Tuni a nna ka va sepna pa min Boaz ahi,” achi hi.
Naomi in amounu kiang ah, "TOUPA, mihing leh misi tung a ahehpihna tawp tuan ngei lou in amah vualzawl hen,” achi hi. Naomi in akiang ah, "Huai mi, i kinaihpih, i tanau bul ei ve,” achi hi.
Moab mi Ruth in, "Kei kiang a leng hon chi ei ve,” achi hi.
Naomi in amounu Ruth kiang ah, "Ka tanu, lou dang a ahon muh hetlouhna ding in asikha nungakte lak ngen ah pai lechin ahoih ding," achi hi.
Huchi in barli buh leh buhpi lak khit mateng Boaz sikha nungakte lak kia ah buhsang zong in ahoh a, api kiang ah ateng hi.
